correctness.rationale: Yoshinaga Corollary 5.4 proves ker(gamma_Q)=span_Q(1,w) for a single affine curve plus infinity; Proposition 7.2 proves precisely N=(a-1)(b-1)/2 ordinary real nodes and N+2 chambers. For a vertical regular fibre T_a(t)=x, the k<=a real preimages have alternating signs of T_a prime. The winding at a point is a subset sum of these signs, hence lies between -floor(a/2) and ceil(a/2), at most a+1 integer levels. Thus dim Q[w]<=a+1. Comparing with N+2 proves positive deficiency except (2,3). For (2,3), explicit regular sample points exhibit winding -1,0,1 and interpolation yields all functions. The all-parameter inequality and zero-parameter boundaries are proven, not inferred from finite testing.
